scripts/error_catalog_shell.sh

Shell · Tier B

Present canonical launcher failures through the dependency-free catalog CLI.

Usage

Source this helper, then call error_catalog_emit with a stable catalog reference.

Inputs

First argument is an error reference; an optional second argument is a safe field name.

Side effects

Prints a bounded diagnostic to stderr; does not exit or change caller state.

Cleanup

No services, temporary files, retries or environment activation are created.

@see src/error_catalog/main.py
